evidence: The Lix Aly S( 1:1) growth is quite linear, and shows mass increases of approximately 13.1 ng cm^{-2} during each Li2 S cycle and 12.4 ng cm^{-2} during each Al2 S 3 cycle. Assuming bulk densities for these compounds, these mass changes imply thickness changes of0.79 nm per cycle forLi2 S and 0.53 nm per cycle forAl2 S 3, so that the average growth rate was 0.66 nm per cycle. Ex situ spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) measurements performed on Lix Aly S( 1:1) deposited on Si(100) yield a refractive index of n = 2.77 at 633 nm and a growth rate of0.50 nm per cycle. This smaller growth compared to the value derived from QCM may result from interactions between the Li2 S and Al2 S 3 to produce a film that is denser than either of the pure compounds. The QCM measurement scan also be used to estimate the composition of the Lix Aly S( 1:1) ALD films. Assuming stoichiometric growth of Li2 S and Al2 S 3, the QCM measurements for Lix Aly S( 1:1) imply an atomic ratio of Li/Al of approximately 3.5. Ex situ measurements performed on Lix Aly S( 1:1) films deposited on Si(100) substrates by using inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP–MS) yielded Li/Al= 2.9, which is in good agreement with the QCM measurements.
